trigger: A local user replaces their own HKCU Lxss key (or a distribution key) with a registry link; REG_OPTION_OPEN_LINK opens the link object itself, which carries no values and no children.
summary: A planted registry link was not detected: the walk reported read_ok with zero rows, no token and possibly status supported. Derived HIGH (I3, E3); the reviewer's native label was MEDIUM.
classification_rationale: The README and ledger claimed a link is never read through; nothing reported one.

summary: Fixed in a5944c045: is_link_key() does one budget-charged SymbolicLinkValue size probe on the opened Lxss key and on every GUID child; a link emits the new token lxss_link (23rd entry of the closed table). Confirmed on a real Windows host 2026-11-08 (LocalSystem capture, disposable account): link at Lxss, link at a distribution key and a decoy REG_SZ value all reported lxss_link with constrained status and no decoy rows; a mutant that suppresses the walk loses the rows.

trigger: tests/test_plugin_readmes.py needs a sample block for every supported or constrained leg; docs/samples/windows.txt had no wsl block.
policy_floor: a broken or red test leg that this change introduced
summary: The docs suite was red at the reviewed HEAD until the real-host captures landed (conditional policy floor).
classification_rationale: A required sample block was missing until the Windows capture.

summary: Fixed in 6c277ec24: windows, linux and macos samples recaptured on real hosts and stamped at leg-hash 2a955b994291, README, plugin docs and index regenerated; meson test --suite docs 114 ok, 0 fail, 2 skipped by design (braga).

trigger: An erasure or decommission pass reads the response-store row and misses virtualization.wsl rows (account folder name and distribution names).
summary: The data-inventory doc did not list virtualization.wsl as a per-user result class (retention, readers, erasure source).
classification_rationale: A required inventory entry for a new per-user data class was missing.

summary: Fixed in a5944c045 and ec5e8c78e: wsl added to the erasure-source list and the transient per-user table, with the 90-day retention, Response:Read readership and the generic response.read row, in plain wording.

trigger: An operator runs windows.virtualization.wsl fleet-wide while some agents still run virtualization 1.0.0, which answers unknown action: wsl with exit 1.
summary: The changelog fragment had no mixed-fleet note for a new action on an existing plugin.
classification_rationale: A version-skew note is the documented precedent for new actions on existing plugins.

summary: Fixed in a5944c045: one sentence added to the fragment; the release-time minAgentVersion pin is an issue draft, not filed.

trigger: A WSL State value of 3 to 6 is shown under a label the repo cannot verify.
summary: state_token labels States 3, 4, 5 and 6; only 1 (installed) had been observed on a measured host.
classification_rationale: A wrong label would read as correct.

summary: Fixed in a5944c045: the labels were checked against the public WSL service enum, 7 (compacting) added, 0 and 2 deliberately fall to state_<n>, and the source is cited in a comment.

trigger: A profile on a stalled fixed volume holds the process-wide offline-hive lock with no deadline; other with_user_hive callers queue behind it and the agent command pool can wedge.
summary: The disclosed no-deadline residual, quantified at about 6 stalls per dead profile; shared by every with_user_hive consumer.
classification_rationale: Quantification of a disclosed, owner-accepted residual; the wsl action adds one more default-on caller.

summary: Disclosed in the README, the privilege-model row and the ledger (worst case 512 serial mount and unload cycles, bounded by the profile cap, not the call budget). Lock caller tag, unload retry and mount audit event are shared-helper work: issue drafts D-1, D-2, D-7, not filed.

trigger: One hostile Lxss subtree writes many large escaped values; the dispatch byte budget is spent by one hive and later profiles are never read.
summary: No per-hive byte allowance existed although the header claimed one hostile hive cannot starve the profiles after it.
classification_rationale: The code did not do what the header comment claimed.

summary: Fixed in 6bcad712c: per-hive byte allowance (32 KiB) ends only that hive; a production-limit test reproduces the starvation and fails without the cap. reporter_ref is unresolved: the review report lives only in the run directory.

trigger: A profile record with an unusable ProfileImagePath sets only a flag, not a record failure; the shell consumed only record failures.
summary: A malformed profile record could produce an unconstrained supported result with unresolved accounts shown as -.
classification_rationale: The README promised profile_unreadable whenever a profile record cannot be read.

summary: Fixed in 6bcad712c: collect_wsl adds the deduplicated profile_unreadable token from the per-profile flag; mutation-checked tests for the live, not-found and once-only cases.

trigger: Sustained out-of-memory while a hive unload fails: wire_field allocates inside a catch arm.
summary: log_unload_failed may throw inside catch(...) and replace the original exception, dropping the actionable log line.
classification_rationale: The failure surface stays the single ABI catch; only a log line is lost.

summary: Rejected by the gate Architect on code evidence: the only throwing call is a std::string allocation, the outer execute_action catch still contains it, and spdlog swallows its own formatting errors; the log-before-throw ordering is pinned by the lexical test.
